context: You recently recruited Lae'zel, a githyanki, into your party; she remains only semi‑hostile and comes from a militaristic people that have been affected (infected) by their mortal enemy. Off‑screen she’s reacting to your handling of someone she calls “my queen’s enemy,” and in this scene she accuses you and warns you not to trust “the one inside.” Lae'zel is paranoid and quick to object if you spare those who oppose her people or the Absolute. She may also attempt a psychic intrusion (a mindmeld) into your memories here, and you can either open your mind to her or shut her out.
